verdict.rationale: Penpot has no dedicated 'sandbox' or 'test environment' feature, but its self-hosting capability (docker-compose/Kubernetes deployment, MCP server deployable in your own environment) means an AI-native user could spin up an isolated instance separate from production to test agent workflows. This is an indirect workaround rather than a purpose-built sandbox/staging mode. Missing for 10: an explicit sandbox/staging environment feature, documented separation of test vs production data within the same account, and any first-party guidance on safely testing AI agents against non-production data.
